# tests/test_data/sincos_angle.txt -- input for probes/substrate/probe_sin_cos_pair.d
# and tests/test_substrate_sin_cos_pair.cpp. One angle per line: its IEEE-754 double
# encoding printed as a 64-bit unsigned integer in hex (so "3ff0000000000000" is 1.0,
# with no decimal text and no rounding anywhere in the path), then a tag:
#   ctrl  an angle where g++'s fused sincos() and two separate libm calls agree
#   div   an angle where they DISAGREE -- found by scanning 6e7 draws spread over
#         0..2pi, compiled -O3 -ffp-contract=off. This list is the discriminating
#         set for T-920: if the port ever lets the pair fuse, the div rows go red.
# Regenerate the div rows with the command in reports/task-log.md, T-920 section.
